note: requests-23 for fr-0100 (verify step of efs-fsx-t02 and efs-fsx-t03). Built like elb-tagging-api-getresources-elb-resources. The Tagging API Welcome page lists Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) among the services that work with the Tagging API (a list item, not quotable); the only GetResources exception it names is IAM users and roles. GetResources is Regional, so the verify call must run in each Region where the task created a file system (efs-fsx-t03: the source in us-east-1 and the replica in us-west-2, as its verify already says).
